title: Simulation code for: Velocity of a Quantum Particle in a Classically Forbidden Region
description:
GPU (CuPy) split-step simulation of a Gaussian wavepacket scattering off a potential step in a coupled double-well waveguide, with Bohmian-trajectory integration and dwell-time analysis. This is the code that produced the figures of the accompanying paper by C. Beck, S. Goldstein, D. Lazarovici, R. Tumulka and N. Zanghì.

A correct build prints hbar*J0 = 26.2 ueV at startup and satisfies d0 = -Delta - hbar*J0 exactly (d0 = +0.017510 at DETUNING_MEV = -0.07).
